rules.statement: The State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act includes buildings standing on state lands within its definition of 'land'.
rules.supporting_quote: The purpose of the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act as amended is to recover possession of the state lands from persons in unauthorized possession or occupation of such land. Section 18 makes it abundantly clear that land is taken to include buildings standing thereon.
